commits.subject: score + pulse + harness (SMB-AUDITION-UI): mixer and routing editor, bus effect keyframes, exact seek through long tails

capabilities_done: (1) viewer mixer and routing editor (harness view::mixer, feature audio-batch): Viewer::open_mixer(sequence, rate, block, sources, extents); strips for audio and submix tracks (fader dB, pan, mute, solo, output combo, sends with level / pre-post, add send, post-fader peak meter) and a master strip (volume, peak, momentary / short-term / integrated LUFS from score's BS.1770 meter); MixerEdit API = UI requests; each edit ONE undo step: track volume/pan/mute/solo through the new Run::submit_sequence (session timeline step, undo/redo by its inverse; HistoryStep.timeline), routing (output, sends, master volume) through the audio_routing entry as an entry-only step; the bus stream is rebuilt after every edit/undo/redo and moved back to the play position; Viewer::mixer_render renders and updates meters; state_json.mixer; egui panel ids mixer.panel, mixer.<track_id>.{volume,pan,mute,solo,output,send.<id>,add_send,meter}, mixer.master.{volume,meter}

(2) keyframes on bus effects: score MixGraph bus and master effects are automatable stacks (BusSpec/MasterSpec effects: Vec<EffectSlot>; lanes set before each sample their value changes at, evaluated at the timeline sample each stage reads, stage latencies summed); pulse EffectFactory returns EffectSlot; harness bus_effect turns stored instance keyframes (ticks from the sequence start, exact sample grid) into lanes of score-automatable parameters (others refused)

(3) seek exactness with long tails via pre-roll: score SeekMode::Exact (default): a forward seek renders on from the current position, a backward seek re-renders from sample 0 (pre-roll = the whole history), so output after any seek is the continuous render bit for bit; SeekMode::Preroll{seconds} keeps the fast warm-up for hosts that choose it; proven with a 4 s RT60 reverb on a bus (exact forward and backward bit-equal; a 1 s pre-roll is measurably not)
meters: score GraphMeters (strip and bus post-fader sample peaks, master peak, master loudness), reset on seek/reset; pulse TimelineBusStream::meters / strip_tracks / bus_tracks

tests.argv: lane worktree, STUDIO_OWNER=smb-audition-ui: cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-score --test audition_session --test session --test session_fades --test session_latency --test chain_mix --test loudness (23/23); -p hsk-studio-pulse --test bus_mix --test playback_audio --test playback_mix_stream --test foundation_contract (10/10, after rebase 1); -p hsk-studio-harness --features media,audio-batch,audio-device --test audio_mixer --test audio_session --test audio_batch --test audio_import --test viewer_audio --test viewer_layers (17/17, re-run after each rebase); clippy score lib+tests, pulse lib+tests, harness lib + audio_mixer: no findings in lane files
cases: harness audio_mixer: mixer_edits_are_single_undo_steps_and_drive_the_bus_mix_and_meters (5 edits = 5 steps, refusals no step, hand values, track peaks, -23 LUFS +-0.1, undo x5 / redo restores document and routing, egui frame ids, save/reopen)

next: Validator: judge 1d4e8e5 (score bus.rs stacks/SeekMode/GraphMeters + session.rs next_change pub(crate) + lib.rs; pulse bus_mix.rs; harness harness.rs submit_sequence + HistoryStep.timeline hook, view/mixer.rs, view/mod.rs hooks, audio_session.rs bus_effect, audio_batch.rs pub(crate) build_automatable; tests) with --features media,audio-batch,audio-device.

not_proven: NOT_PROVEN: real audio device output and a windowed (desktop) mixer session: headless egui and the software provider only
NOT_PROVEN: Exact seek cost: a backward seek re-renders from the start (proportional to the position); hosts needing instant scrubbing can choose SeekMode::Preroll (approximate for long tails)
NOT_PROVEN: Adobe Audition mixer parity (layout, meter ballistics: peaks here are sample peaks since the last reset, no decay)
NOT_PROVEN: bus effect add/remove/reorder from the panel (API stores bus_effects in the routing record; the panel edits faders, pan, mute, solo, outputs and sends)
